parole.significato: A member of a people of Krasnoyarsk Krai in Central Siberia, Russia.
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Ket кеʼт (keˀt, “human being”), via Russian.

parole.significato: A Yeniseian people of central Siberia.
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Ket Юг (Jùk ~ Jūk, “Yug person (term used for men)”), via Russian. Yug people's endonym was Yug Дьуʼк (Dʲuˀk).
